evals.name: tostato-coffee
evals.prompt: Make a full brand kit for Tostato, a small specialty coffee roaster in Lugano. They sell beans by subscription online and supply ~30 cafés in Ticino. The owner wants it warm and premium but not hipster-cliché, and it has to work on bags, a web shop and Instagram.
evals.expected_output: Complete brand folder + review page: strategy with real competitor research, logo that survives 16 px and a coffee-bag label, OKLCH tokens with contrast table, OFL type, landing (web shop) + one product screen, applications incl. a bag label mock.

evals.name: scraping-api-noname
evals.prompt: I'm launching a web-scraping API for developers and data teams (LLM-ready extraction, schema in → JSON out). No name yet, need one. I love brutalist / terminal vibes. Do the whole brand: name, logo, system, landing.
evals.expected_output: Naming phase with domain checks and a ★ pick, then the full system; dark-leaning dev-tool brand that is not a generic hacker-green cliché.

evals.name: franco-finance-reference
evals.prompt: Brand for Franco, a personal-finance app for expats living in Switzerland (pillar 3a, taxes, budgeting in CHF). Look at my other brand's branding.md (a strict Vercel-like token system) for the level of rigour I want, but don't copy it. Light theme, trustworthy, a bit witty.
evals.expected_output: Full system with rigour comparable to the reference doc but its own identity: no look-alike logo, palette or layout.
